usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.beta.threads.messages.list("thread_id", limit: 20, order: "asc", after: "after", before: "before", run_id: "run_id")
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.beta.threads.messages.list(thread_id, limit: nil, order: nil, after: nil, before: nil, run_id: nil) -> Page<Models::MessageObject>

fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 20.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order by the `created_at` timestamp of the objects. `asc` for ascending order and `desc` for descending order.

fields.name: after
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.

fields.name: before
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include before=obj_foo in order to fetch the previous page of the list.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Filter messages by the run ID that generated them.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `thread.message`.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the message was created.

fields.name: thread_id
fields.description: The [thread](/docs/api-reference/threads) ID that this message belongs to.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The status of the message, which can be either `in_progress`, `incomplete`, or `completed`.

fields.name: role
fields.description: The entity that produced the message. One of `user` or `assistant`.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The content of the message in array of text and/or images.
